title: IPIP Modesty — 10 items
source: International Personality Item Pool, preliminary NEO-like facet A5: Modesty. IPIP item set, not the proprietary NEO-PI-R instrument.
license: Public domain; commercial and non-commercial use permitted by IPIP.
limitations: Self-description responses only; modest language does not demonstrate calibrated uncertainty or humility in behavior. Overlaps with other IPIP scales.
instruction: Indicate how accurately the following statement describes you as you generally are now. Respond as yourself, not as a fictional character. Each statement completes: I...

items.text: Dislike being the center of attention.
Believe that I am better than others.
Have a high opinion of myself.
Know the answers to many questions.
Make myself the center of attention.
